Bill.BriefDescription: Eliminating the Columbia River Gorge Compact.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to eliminating the Columbia River Gorge Compact;creating a new section; and repealing RCW 43.97.015, 43.97.025,43.97.035, 35.22.700, 35.63.150, 35A.63.200, 36.32.550, 36.70.980, and90.58.600.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature torepeal the Columbia River Gorge Compact with the Congress of the UnitedStates and the state of Oregon due to the financial constraints facingthe state. While the legislature recognizes the importance of theColumbia River Gorge National Scenic Area Act, P.L. 99963, it finds itcan no longer support the financial obligations under this interstatecompact. The legislature intends to renegotiate the compact whenfinancial circumstances improve.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 43.97.015 (Columbia River Gorge CompactColumbia RiverGorge commission) and 1987 c 499 s 1; p. 1 SHB 3132 RCW 43.97.025 (Grant of authorityAppointment of members tocommissionVacancies) and 1987 c 499 s 2; RCW 43.97.035 (Commission membersCompensationTravelexpenses) and 1987 c 499 s 3; RCW 35.22.700 (Conformance with chapter 43.97 RCW required) and1987 c 499 s 5; RCW 35.63.150 (Conformance with chapter 43.97 RCW required) and1987 c 499 s 6; RCW 35A.63.200 (Conformance with chapter 43.97 RCW required)and 1987 c 499 s 7; RCW 36.32.550 (Conformance with chapter 43.97 RCW required) and1987 c 499 s 8; RCW 36.70.980 (Conformance with chapter 43.97 RCW required) and1987 c 499 s 9; and RCW 90.58.600 (Conformance with chapter 43.97 RCW required) and1987 c 499 s 10.
